items.name: animated-content

items.name: blob-cursor

items.name: click-spark

items.description: Bursts of sparks at every click, as dashes, comets, dots or stars, that can spill around buttons.

items.name: crosshair
items.title: Crosshair
items.description: Crosshair cursor with live coordinates that locks onto links and buttons and measures them.

items.name: crystalized-ball
items.title: CrystalizedBall
items.description: A glass ball with a crackling electric rim and glowing dust that swirls with the cursor.

items.name: cubes
items.title: Cubes
items.description: A grid of outlined 3D cubes that turn to face the cursor, spin when swept and ripple on click.

items.name: cursor-grid
items.title: Cursor Grid
items.description: A crisp grid whose cells light up and fade behind the cursor, with grid styles, tiles and click pulses.

items.name: dither-veil
items.title: DitherVeil
items.description: A 1-bit dithered photo the cursor burns through to full colour, knitting back cell by cell.

items.name: elastic-mesh
items.title: ElasticMesh
items.description: Turns text or any logo into a puffy inflated shape you can press, poke and stretch like jelly.

items.name: electric-border
items.title: Electric Border
items.description: Wraps any element in crackling strands of current that surge near the cursor and leap off in sparks.

items.name: electric-logo
items.title: Electric Logo
items.description: Turns any logo into a living lightning outline, with arcs that leap off its edges.

items.name: fade-content
items.title: Fade Content
items.description: Wrapper that fades content in on scroll, plain or out of focus, from washed-out gray, or through grain, mist and pixel blocks.

items.name: ghost-cursor
items.title: GhostCursor
items.description: A ghost of glowing smoke that floats after the cursor and curls away as it rises.

items.name: glare-hover
items.title: GlareHover
items.description: A glossy light streak that sweeps across any element in the direction the cursor moves.

items.name: glow-cursor
items.title: GlowCursor
items.description: Light that pours from the cursor, drifts softly through the air and cools as it fades.

items.name: gradual-blur
items.title: Gradual Blur
items.description: Progressive edge blur for headers, footers, captions and carousels, with an optional fade to color that hides at the ends of a scroll.

items.name: halftone-reveal
items.title: HalftoneReveal
items.description: A halftone print of an image whose dots swell into the real photo under the cursor.

items.name: image-trail
items.title: Image Trail
items.description: Cursor-based image trail with several built-in variants.

items.name: laser-flow
items.title: Laser Flow
items.description: A beam of light that splashes onto your content and pours over its corners.

items.name: logo-loop
items.title: Logo Loop
items.description: Continuously looping marquee of brand or tech logos with seamless repeat and hover pause.

items.name: magnet
items.title: Magnet
items.description: Elements magnetically ease toward the cursor then settle back with spring physics.

items.name: meta-balls
items.title: MetaBalls
items.description: Liquid metaballs that merge, stretch and pinch apart, with a cursor blob that pushes through them.

items.name: metallic-paint
items.title: Metallic Paint
items.description: Liquid chrome that flows over your logo or text, adapted from Paper's Liquid Metal shader.

items.name: noise
items.title: Noise
items.description: Film grain overlay for photos and pages, from fine 35mm grain to dust, paper and TV static.

items.name: orbit-images
items.title: Orbit Images
items.description: SVG Path customizable orbiting images effect

items.name: pixel-swap
items.title: PixelSwap
items.description: New content builds in pixel by pixel in a springy wave that starts wherever the cursor enters.

items.name: pixel-trail
items.title: PixelTrail
items.description: Glossy pixels melt into a fluid goo trail behind the cursor, with color shifts and drips.

items.name: pixel-transition
items.title: Pixel Transition
items.description: Retro pixel dissolve that covers a card in solid pixels, swaps the content underneath and clears again.

items.name: ribbons
items.title: Ribbons
items.description: Springy ribbons that trail the cursor, in lens, comet or even shapes with an optional wave.

items.name: ripple-distortion
items.title: RippleDistortion
items.description: Pointer-driven water displacement that warps content and leaves a decaying wake.

items.name: scroll-expand
items.title: Scroll Expand
items.description: A media box that grows to fullscreen as you scroll, with a fading title, hint, and overlay content.

items.name: shape-blur
items.title: ShapeBlur
items.description: A crisp logo or shape that drifts out of focus under the pointer like a camera lens.

items.name: splash-cursor
items.title: Splash Cursor
items.description: A fluid simulation that trails the cursor in swirling ink and bursts into a splash on click.

items.name: star-border
items.title: StarBorder
items.description: A twinkling star that travels the exact outline of any button, pill or card, trailing light and stardust.

items.name: sticker-peel
items.title: Sticker Peel
items.description: A die-cut sticker you can peel at any edge, drag, throw and swing, in gloss, matte or holographic finishes.

items.name: strands
items.title: Strands
items.description: Spectral strands that twist inside a frosted glass orb and swell into a smooth bulge where they come together, like the new Siri.

items.name: swarm-cursor
items.title: SwarmCursor
items.description: A liquid swarm of particles that flows after the cursor, curls into eddies and pours around hovered buttons.

items.name: target-cursor
items.title: TargetCursor
items.description: A reticle cursor whose corner brackets snap around targets, matching their shape.

items.name: acid-squares
items.title: Acid Squares
items.description: A rolling field of glossy squares that ripples under two drifting colored lights.

items.name: aero-shards
items.title: Aero Shards
items.description: Silk ribbons of thick glass shards streaming on layered depths among survey markers, catching light along their edges.

items.name: antigravity
items.title: Antigravity
items.description: A field of particles that lifts into a glowing ring around the cursor and bursts outward on click.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: A soft, calm aurora that flows across the top of the page and drifts toward the cursor.

items.name: balatro
items.title: Balatro
items.description: The swirling Balatro paint shader, with crisp pixels, a cursor that stirs the paint and click whirlpools.

items.name: ballpit
items.title: Ballpit
items.description: A soft-lit pit of physics balls you can shove with the cursor, grab, throw and blast apart.

items.name: beams
items.title: Beams
items.description: Glossy ribbons that ripple in the dark and catch the light, which follows your cursor.

items.name: crt-warp
items.title: CRT Warp
items.description: A blocky plasma glowing on a curved CRT, with real scanlines, a phosphor mask, afterglow and a power-on intro.

items.name: color-bends
items.title: Color Bends
items.description: Vibrant color bends with smooth flowing animation.

items.name: dark-veil
items.title: DarkVeil
items.description: A silky veil of light that drifts in the dark and bends around the cursor.

items.name: dither
items.title: Dither
items.description: Retro dithered waves with Bayer, halftone, line and noise patterns, palettes and cursor trails.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: DotField
items.description: A gradient dot field seen through a lens that follows the cursor, magnifying, pinching or swirling the dots.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: A springy dot grid that the cursor flicks and drags through like jelly, with click shockwaves.

items.name: evil-eye
items.title: Evil Eye
items.description: Reactive evil eye background with cursor-tracked pupil.

items.name: faulty-terminal
items.title: Faulty Terminal
items.description: A flickering CRT terminal of glowing glyphs, with phosphor trails under the cursor and glitches on click.

items.name: ferrofluid
items.title: Ferrofluid
items.description: A glossy sea of magnetic fluid where swells of spikes roll in and the cursor raises a crown.

items.name: floating-lines
items.title: Floating Lines
items.description: Ribbons of fine glowing lines that drift in waves, part around the cursor and curl when clicked.

items.name: flux-lines
items.title: Flux Lines
items.description: Glowing flux lines tracing a churning magnetic fluid. The cursor magnet reveals and curls them.

items.name: galaxy
items.title: Galaxy
items.description: Endless flight through a twinkling starfield with warp jumps, cursor repulsion and star palettes.

items.name: ghost-fibers
items.title: Ghost Fibers
items.description: Layered ribbons of fine glowing fibers that twist, fold and drift through soft depth of field.

items.name: gradient-ascii
items.title: Gradient ASCII
items.description: Soft gradient glows drawn in ASCII characters that scramble under the cursor.

items.name: gradient-blinds
items.title: Gradient Blinds
items.description: Satin gradient blinds lit by a spotlight that follows the cursor, swaying and turning toward the light.

items.name: gradient-waves
items.title: Gradient Waves
items.description: Lit satin waves rolling in from a hazy horizon, with a light that follows the cursor and swells on click.

items.name: grainient
items.title: Grainient
items.description: Flowing grainy gradients you can stir with the cursor.

items.name: grid-distortion
items.title: Grid Distortion
items.description: Image background that breaks into a grid of blocks under the cursor and settles back into place.

items.name: grid-motion
items.title: Grid Motion
items.description: A tilted wall of drifting tiles that slides with the pointer and lights up where it rests.

items.name: grid-scan
items.title: GridScan
items.description: A 3D grid room swept by a scanning light that follows your view.

items.name: holo-mosaic
items.title: HoloMosaic
items.description: Holographic tiles that split light into sweeping color as it moves, with glitter, a flip-in intro and click waves.

items.name: hyperspeed
items.title: Hyperspeed
items.description: Night highway of glowing light trails on a winding road that warps into hyperspace while you hold.

items.name: iridescence
items.title: Iridescence
items.description: Liquid iridescent surface with shifting folds that you can stir with the cursor.

items.name: letter-glitch
items.title: Letter Glitch
items.description: A calm field of letters that flicker, scramble and glitch in color, stirred by the cursor and torn by clicks.

items.name: light-pillar
items.title: LightPillar
items.description: A swirling pillar of light that ignites on load, leans toward the cursor and surges on click.

items.name: light-rays
items.title: LightRays
items.description: Volumetric light rays from any edge, with source glow and haze. The cursor steers the beam and casts a shadow.

items.name: light-tunnel
items.title: LightTunnel
items.description: A swirling fibre-optic tunnel where comets of light race into depth, steered by the cursor.

items.name: lightfall
items.title: Lightfall
items.description: Streaks of light falling down a curved tunnel, bending around the cursor and stretching into warp trails on hold.

items.name: lightning
items.title: Lightning
items.description: Crackling, branching lightning that bends toward the cursor and strikes wherever you click.

items.name: line-waves
items.title: Line Waves
items.description: Fine lines that flow in silky waves while a band of light drifts through them.

items.name: liquid-chrome
items.title: LiquidChrome
items.description: Soft ribbons of liquid chrome that swirl through a dark pool, ripple under the cursor and catch the light as it moves.

items.name: liquid-ether
items.title: Liquid Ether
items.description: A glowing liquid that swirls under the cursor, colored by how fast it flows.

items.name: magic-rings
items.title: Magic Rings
items.description: Glowing rings that pulse outward in a wave, swell toward the cursor and flare on click.

items.name: magnet-lines
items.title: Magnet Lines
items.description: A field of magnetic lines that swing toward the cursor, ripple outward and spin with every click.

items.name: micro-slats
items.title: Micro Slats
items.description: A wall of tiny slats that becomes a rolling sea in perspective, with glinting crests.

items.name: molten-metal
items.title: MoltenMetal
items.description: Swirling caustic filaments with white-hot cores that heat up under the cursor and flare on click.

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: A glowing ring of swirling color that breathes, trails an orbiting light and reaches toward the cursor.

items.name: particles
items.title: Particles
items.description: A drifting 3D field of particles with glow, twinkle, constellation lines and cursor interaction.

items.name: pattern-waves
items.title: Pattern Waves
items.description: A lit halftone surface of dots, lines or glyphs that moves like draped silk.

items.name: pixel-blast
items.title: PixelBlast
items.description: Dithered pixel clouds that drift, shimmer and light up under the cursor, with ripples, shapes and a perspective floor.

items.name: pixel-snow
items.title: PixelSnow
items.description: Pixel-art snowflakes drifting down in layers of depth, brushed aside by the cursor.

items.name: plasma
items.title: Plasma
items.description: Folds of satin light twisting slowly through the dark, turning to follow the cursor.

items.name: plasma-wave
items.title: PlasmaWave
items.description: Two ribbons of plasma curling through each other, with soft glow and white-hot cores.

items.name: prism
items.title: Prism
items.description: Rotating prism of glowing spectral light with configurable shape, colors and motion.

items.name: prismatic-burst
items.title: Prismatic Burst
items.description: A burst of prismatic light rays that leans toward the cursor and sends a wave of light outward on click.

items.name: radar
items.title: Radar
items.description: A radar scope whose sweep leaves a phosphor afterglow and picks up moving contacts.

items.name: ripple-grid
items.title: Ripple Grid
items.description: A crisp grid that ripples like water, bending and lighting up as waves pass through it.

items.name: scanner
items.title: Scanner
items.description: Glowing interference lines swept by a scan beam, with a CRT finish, cursor lensing and click pings.

items.name: shape-grid
items.title: ShapeGrid
items.description: A drifting grid of shapes that lights up under the cursor, with perspective tilt and rainbow trails.

items.name: shape-waves
items.title: Shape Waves
items.description: A field of triangles, circles and squares that brighten and grow along rolling waves.

items.name: side-rays
items.title: SideRays
items.description: Shafts of light that fan in from a corner or side, shimmer slowly and lean toward the cursor.

items.name: silk
items.title: Silk
items.description: Flowing satin folds with glossy highlights that turn toward the cursor and ripple on click.

items.name: sliced-waves
items.title: SlicedWaves
items.description: Waves of colored light sliced into glowing bars, seen in depth with a focus that follows the cursor.

items.name: soft-aurora
items.title: Soft Aurora
items.description: Soft aurora borealis shader with 3D Perlin noise and cosine gradient palettes.

items.name: threads
items.title: Threads
items.description: Flowing threads that fray apart and part around the cursor, from fine silk to contour lines.

items.name: topography
items.title: Topography
items.description: A 3D landscape drawn in glowing contour lines that rises under the cursor, with light pulses on click.

items.name: waves
items.title: Waves
items.description: Dense flowing lines that sway like silk, bend around the cursor and spring back into place.

items.name: web-threads
items.title: Web Threads
items.description: Glowing threads woven through luminous pinch points that light up under the cursor and carry light on click.

items.name: accordion-gallery
items.title: AccordionGallery
items.description: Panels expand on hover or focus, revealing parallax imagery and captions.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: A scrolling list whose rows spring into view, with a gliding selection and arrow keys.

items.name: border-glow
items.title: Border Glow
items.description: Glowing mesh-gradient border that follows cursor direction and intensifies near edges.

items.name: bounce-cards
items.title: Bounce Cards
items.description: A fan of photo cards that bounce in, then spread apart and straighten the one you hover.

items.name: bubble-menu
items.title: Bubble Menu
items.description: Pill-style overlay nav with staggered GSAP bubble entrance animation.

items.name: card-nav
items.title: Card Nav
items.description: A navigation bar that springs open into a row of cards, each with its own links.

items.name: card-swap
items.title: Card Swap
items.description: A 3D stack of cards that sends the front card to the back on a timer, or when you fling it.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Swipeable cards for feature tours, stories and galleries, with five transitions and an autoplay timer.

items.name: chroma-grid
items.title: Chroma Grid
items.description: A grid of grayscale photo cards where a spotlight follows the cursor and brings back color.

items.name: circular-carousel
items.title: CircularCarousel
items.description: A 3D ring of images with bendable cards, momentum drag, snapping and click to focus.

items.name: circular-gallery
items.title: CircularGallery
items.description: A curved image gallery you can drag, scroll or tab through, with cards that open to the full image.

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: An odometer-style number whose digits roll to every new value, with currency, separators and locales.

items.name: curved-input
items.title: CurvedInput
items.description: Arc-bent input bar with text, caret and submit button all following the curve.

items.name: decay-card
items.title: Decay Card
items.description: An image card that tears and melts as the pointer moves, then pulls itself back together.

items.name: depth-carousel
items.title: DepthCarousel
items.description: Cards recede into depth on a 3D rail, with drag, keyboard and auto-advance.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: macOS style dock with smooth magnification, launch bounce, badges and context menus.

items.name: dome-gallery
items.title: Dome Gallery
items.description: Draggable 3D image dome with momentum, click-to-enlarge, and dome blur overlays.

items.name: drift-wall
items.title: DriftWall
items.description: An endless perspective wall of tiles drifting past, lifting on hover.

items.name: elastic-slider
items.title: ElasticSlider
items.description: A slider that grows under your cursor and stretches like rubber when pulled past either end, then springs back.

items.name: flex-carousel
items.title: Flex Carousel
items.description: An infinite image row that flows through invisible liquid glass at its edges.

items.name: flowing-menu
items.title: Flowing Menu
items.description: A full-height menu with a liquid band that glides between rows and reveals a scrolling marquee of each item.

items.name: fluid-glass
items.title: Fluid Glass
items.description: A 3D glass object that refracts your headline, image or video, follows the cursor and melts between shapes.

items.name: flying-posters
items.title: Flying Posters
items.description: 3D posters that twist and flip as you scroll or drag through an endless column.

items.name: folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: Folder that drops its flap open or swings open like a book, with pages you can pick.

items.name: glass-icons
items.title: GlassIcons
items.description: Liquid glass icons that bend the color behind them, for app grids, docks and social links.

items.name: glass-surface
items.title: Glass Surface
items.description: Apple-style liquid glass that bends what is behind it, in a rounded panel or any logo shape.

items.name: gooey-nav
items.title: GooeyNav
items.description: A navigation bar whose active pill breaks into goo that flows over to the item you pick.

items.name: holo-card
items.title: HoloCard
items.description: Collectible trading card with a real holographic foil and glitter that sparkles as it tilts.

items.name: infinite-menu
items.title: Infinite Menu
items.description: A draggable sphere of image tiles that snaps the nearest one forward and shows its title.

items.name: infinite-spiral
items.title: Infinite Spiral
items.description: An endlessly looping 3D helix of images with adjustable motion, depth and spacing.

items.name: lanyard
items.title: Lanyard
items.description: Swinging 3D badge on a stretchy woven band that you can drag, throw or click to flip.

items.name: line-sidebar
items.title: LineSidebar
items.description: Static list navigation with a cursor-proximity effect that shifts and highlights nearby items.

items.name: magic-bento
items.title: Magic Bento
items.description: A bento grid of feature cards with live artwork, edge light that follows the cursor and a click wave.

items.name: masonry
items.title: Masonry
items.description: A masonry gallery that springs into place, reflows as it resizes and opens images in a lightbox.

items.name: model-viewer
items.title: Model Viewer
items.description: A product-style 3D model viewer that frames itself and floats over a soft shadow.

items.name: morph-slider
items.title: MorphSlider
items.description: WebGL slider that melts between images with a displacement transition.

items.name: option-wheel
items.title: OptionWheel
items.description: Curved option picker that spins with scroll, drag or arrow keys, tilting items away.

items.name: pill-nav
items.title: Pill Nav
items.description: A pill navigation bar where a fill rises through each link as its label rolls over, with a sliding active dot.

items.name: pixel-card
items.title: Pixel Card
items.description: A card that fills with twinkling pixels on hover, rippling out from the center or the cursor.

items.name: profile-card
items.title: Profile Card
items.description: A framed profile card that tilts toward the cursor, with holographic foil shining through a tiled pattern.

items.name: reflective-card
items.title: Reflective Card
items.description: A metal ID card that reflects your camera or a looping video and catches the light as it tilts.

items.name: scroll-stack
items.title: Scroll Stack
items.description: Cards pin and stack as you scroll, settling back into a dimmed deck with smooth, jitter-free motion.

items.name: specular-button
items.title: Specular Button
items.description: Glass button whose edge catches the light, with a highlight that glides toward the cursor.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: Card lit by a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, catches its edge and reaches nearby cards.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Pile of cards you can drag, flick or click through, with thrown cards tucking underneath.

items.name: staggered-menu
items.title: Staggered Menu
items.description: Full-screen staggered slide-in menu with layered colors and GSAP timelines.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A multi-step flow with a gliding step indicator, spring transitions and horizontal or vertical layouts.

items.name: tilted-card
items.title: Tilted Card
items.description: A 3D card that tilts toward the cursor, with glare, a soft shadow, floating layers and a flip side.

items.name: bell-toggle
items.title: Bell Toggle
items.description: Pill toggle that answers a press at three tempos: the bell rings on damped keyframes, the label blur-crossfades, and the pill unfurls to the longer label through a clip-path on a critically damped spring. The pressed state is the receipt.

items.name: branched-menu
items.title: Branched Menu
items.description: Collapsible menu whose sections unfold into a trunk with a curved branch to each child, and an accent line that travels down the trunk and around the curve to whatever you pick, while a marker glides to the open section.

items.name: call-chip
items.title: Call Chip
items.description: Inline tool-call chip whose fill wipes across while a live ms counter ticks, completing with a green wash on success or stopping short and shaking red with a retry glyph on error.

items.name: code-slots
items.title: Code Slots
items.description: One-time-code input where a hidden overlay input owns focus, paste and SMS autofill while each slot lands its digit on one spring: the fill swells from the centre, the digit rises and the caret glides; a wrong code drains the slots in a cascade, a right one merges them into a single accent wash.

items.name: comet-dial
items.title: Comet Dial
items.description: Tick-ring dial you flick by angle: the reading launches on a spring and a velocity-driven comet streaks behind the lit head, trailing the direction of travel and vanishing at rest.

items.name: dodge-field
items.title: Dodge Field
items.description: Wrapper that makes any child flee the pointer inside a bounded field, dodges once per approach, then relents after a few tries and glides home.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
items.description: Two-faced card that flips in 3D on a click, a drag or a flick, settling on a spring that carries your release velocity, with an optional cursor tilt, a sheen that follows the pointer and a shadow that narrows as it turns edge on.

items.name: folder-float
items.title: FolderFloat
items.description: Folder whose notes spring out into a floating cloud when it opens on hover or press.

items.name: fuse-button
items.title: Fuse Button
items.description: Action button whose done state carries its own undo on a burning fuse: press, the label crossfades to Undo, a hairline burns for the undo window, and Undo or Escape runs it back.

items.name: glide-select
items.title: Glide Select
items.description: Select chip whose menu pops out of its own corner and whose single hover highlight glides between rows, remembering where you left it so re-entry slides from there instead of blinking in.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold Button
items.description: Hold-to-confirm button whose liquid fill rises while pressed, snaps back on an early release and swaps its label through a blur when the hold completes.

items.name: jelly-radio
items.title: Jelly Radio
items.description: Radio group of labelled chips where the chosen one swells wide-then-tall on two springs and barges its neighbours outward with a travelling stagger, so a selection reads as a force moving through the row.

items.name: lattice-loader
items.title: Lattice Loader
items.description: Inline agent-status row: a 3x3 or 4x4 lattice whose cells brighten in a phase-offset wave beside a verb and a live stopwatch, resolving into a check or a cross when the task ends.

items.name: paper-crumple
items.title: PaperCrumple
items.description: An image that crumples into a textured 3D sheet while you hold and drag it.

items.name: peek-rating
items.title: Peek Rating
items.description: Star rating you can try before you commit: sweeping the row lifts a trailing wave of stars up to the pointer while a tip hops along with the label; a click commits with a pop.

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt Bar
items.description: Chat composer with @ sources, / commands, a model picker, dictation and attachments.

items.name: pulse-heart
items.title: Pulse Heart
items.description: Like button that contracts to a dot, flips colour at its smallest frame and pulses back while the count swaps one glyph.

items.name: refine-frame
items.title: Refine Frame
items.description: Reserved-aspect frame that walks any media through queued, generating, refining and complete without layout shift: each stage is one blur, saturate, scale and opacity tween, a soft band sweeps while it works, a chip reports the stage, and an error dims the picture behind a retry pill.

items.name: rubber-segment
items.title: Rubber Segment
items.description: Segmented control with a rubber thumb: taps stretch it across the gap and squash it onto the target, and you can grab, drag and flick it between slots.

items.name: scrub-field
items.title: Scrub Field
items.description: Number chip you drag to scrub: the value follows the hand, pushes past the range on a rubber band, and a click without moving opens it for typing.

items.name: shredder
items.title: Shredder
items.description: A list with a paper shredder at the bottom that cuts dragged rows into curling strips.

items.name: slide-commit
items.title: Slide Commit
items.description: Slide-to-confirm handle that plants with a spinner while your action runs, unfurls into a done pill on success and springs home with a squash and shake on failure.

items.name: sling-button
items.title: Sling Button
items.description: Send button you pull back like a slingshot: the band stretches, a power arc arms it, and releasing fires the action with the flick's velocity.

items.name: slosh-gauge
items.title: Slosh Gauge
items.description: Tank gauge whose liquid chases the value with mass, tilts with its own speed and splashes against the top when it slams full; optionally a vertical slider.

items.name: spring-check
items.title: Spring Check
items.description: Checkbox row where a single spring fills the box, draws the tick, strikes the label and dims the words in one press.

items.name: squish-switch
items.title: Squish Switch
items.description: Drag-scrubbable switch whose thumb stretches by how fast it moves, flips at the midpoint and squashes against the track end on a flick.

items.name: status-mark
items.title: Status Mark
items.description: A 20px status glyph for agent task lists that morphs in place from a dashed idle ring to a spinning or real-progress arc, then draws a check or a cross, with an optional label strike.

items.name: swipe-row
items.title: Swipe Row
items.description: List row that swipes open to reveal actions, snaps by flick velocity, and deletes on a full swipe that stretches the action colour across the row.

items.name: swipe-toast
items.title: Swipe Toast
items.description: Single toast that rises through its bottom edge, swipes down to dismiss on a flick or a distance, and burns a thin fuse for exactly its remaining time; hover pauses it and an inline mode keeps it inside any container.

items.name: tear-ticket
items.title: Tear Ticket
items.description: Ticket whose perforated stub tears off by hand: paper bridges stretch into fibres and snap one by one from the far end, the torn edges are jagged and fit each other, the freed stub dangles and drops, and the body is stamped as used. The artwork tilts in 3D with parallax on hover.

items.name: thought-line
items.title: Thought Line
items.description: Reasoning-trace header: a glyph and a label breathe beside a live clock while steps appear beneath, then the line settles on one beat into "Thought for 4.2s" through a blur crossfade and the trace folds into it.

items.name: voice-pill
items.title: Voice Pill
items.description: Mic button that swells into a tinted capsule of level-driven equalizer bars and an elapsed clock while held or toggled, then relaxes back into the mic on release; simulated voice by default, real microphone as an opt-in.

items.name: wake-slider
items.title: Wake Slider
items.description: Range slider drawn as thin bars with no thumb: drag speed raises a wake that trails behind the handle and flattens again at rest.

items.name: warm-tooltip
items.title: Warm Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip group with one shared delay: the first label waits and pops from its trigger, then siblings open instantly while the group is warm, with an optional velocity lean.

items.name: ascii-text
items.title: ASCII Text
items.description: Waving ASCII text that tilts toward the pointer, scrambles on hover and ripples on click.

items.name: blur-text
items.title: Blur Text
items.description: Text starts blurred then crisply resolves for a soft-focus reveal effect.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: Circular Text
items.description: Layouts characters around a circle with optional rotation animation.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count Up
items.description: Animated number counter supporting formatting and decimals.

items.name: curved-loop
items.title: Curved Loop
items.description: Flowing looping text path along a customizable curve with drag interaction.

items.name: decrypted-text
items.title: Decrypted Text
items.description: Hacker-style decryption cycling random glyphs until resolving to real text.

items.name: depth-text
items.title: Depth Text
items.description: Layered extruded type with parallax that shifts against the pointer.

items.name: echo-text
items.title: Echo Text
items.description: Ghosted copies trail behind the text and settle into a single word.

items.name: falling-text
items.title: Falling Text
items.description: Text that breaks apart and tumbles into a pile you can drag, throw and swipe, then flies back into place.

items.name: fold-text
items.title: Fold Text
items.description: Lines unfold into place like creased paper opening flat.

items.name: fuzzy-text
items.title: Fuzzy Text
items.description: Vibrating fuzzy text with controllable hover intensity.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: RGB split and distortion glitch effect with jitter effects.

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient Text
items.description: Living gradients inside your text: a sliding sweep, a drifting mesh or a swinging conic fan.

items.name: masked-heading
items.title: Masked Heading
items.description: A headline with a drifting colour mesh or image showing through, revealed word by word.

items.name: particle-text
items.title: Particle Text
items.description: Text assembles from drifting particles that scatter and reform on demand.

items.name: rotating-text
items.title: Rotating Text
items.description: Cycles through multiple phrases with slide, flip, blur, scale or drop transitions and an optional highlight block that resizes to fit each word.

items.name: scrambled-text
items.title: Scrambled Text
items.description: Detects cursor position and applies a distortion effect to text.

items.name: scroll-float
items.title: Scroll Float
items.description: Text gently floats / parallax shifts on scroll.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: Scroll Reveal
items.description: Text gently unblurs and reveals on scroll.

items.name: scroll-velocity
items.title: Scroll Velocity
items.description: Text marquee animatio - speed and distortion scale with user's scroll velocity.

items.name: shiny-text
items.title: Shiny Text
items.description: A sheen of light that sweeps across text, from soft bands to chrome-like reflections.

items.name: shuffle
items.title: Shuffle
items.description: Animated text reveal where characters shuffle before settling.

items.name: split-flap-text
items.title: Split Flap Text
items.description: Mechanical split-flap departure board that clacks through to each new phrase.

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: Splits text into characters / words for staggered entrance animation.

items.name: stroke-text
items.title: Stroke Text
items.description: Outlined letterforms draw themselves on, then flood with fill.

items.name: tech-text
items.title: Tech Text
items.description: A wordmark whose letters turn into dashed vector paths under the cursor.

items.name: text-cursor
items.title: Text Cursor
items.description: Text or emoji that trails your cursor as stamped copies, a following chain or a ribbon of letters.

items.name: text-loop
items.title: Text Loop
items.description: A seamless text marquee that flows along curved SVG paths.

items.name: text-pressure
items.title: Text Pressure
items.description: Characters scale / warp interactively based on pointer pressure zone.

items.name: text-type
items.title: Text Type
items.description: Typewriter effect with blinking cursor and adjustable typing cadence.

items.name: true-focus
items.title: True Focus
items.description: Applies dynamic blur / clarity based over a series of words in order.

items.name: variable-proximity
items.title: Variable Proximity
items.description: Letter styling changes continuously with pointer distance mapping.

items.name: warp-text
items.title: Warp Text
items.description: WebGL warp that bends and refracts the text around the pointer.
